import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)

# Display the first few rows and the structure of the dataset
df.head(), df.info()

# Check for negative values in the spending column
negative_spending = df[df['spending'] < 0]

# Calculate total spending per transaction category
total_spending_per_category = df.groupby('type')['spending'].sum().reset_index()

negative_spending, total_spending_per_category

# Exclude negative spending values and recalculate total spending per category
total_spending_excluding_negative = df[df['spending'] >= 0].groupby('type')['spending'].sum().reset_index()

total_spending_excluding_negative
